decks.notes: This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan with a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes, while also utilizing powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck aims to control the board and tempo of the game, using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler to slow down opposing strategies and Nulldrifter to draw cards and generate card advantage. With a mix of control elements and powerful threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game.

The deck focuses on creating a fast and efficient combo using cards like Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to build up a powerful creature. It also includes disruption elements like Soul-Guide Lantern and Malevolent Rumble to control the game. Utilizing the mana acceleration provided by Eldrazi Temple and other lands, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of ramp, card draw, and protection, the deck seeks to execute its game plan smoothly and consistently.

The deck revolves around utilizing creatures such as Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate massive amounts of +1/+1 counters with Blade of the Bloodchief. By controlling the board with removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble, the player aims to build a threatening board presence while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings helps to tutor for key pieces of the combo, while Traverse the Ulvenwald provides additional utility. The deck also features a powerful end-game threat in Emrakul, the Promised End.

This deck aims to generate a high amount of mana quickly using rituals and mana-generating spells in order to cast powerful storm spells like Glimpse the Impossible and Reckless Impulse. The deck also utilizes Ral, Monsoon Mage's ability to copy spells for additional value. Past in Flames allows for spells to be recast from the graveyard, and Wish can be used to fetch specific cards needed for the situation. The deck is focused on casting as many spells in a turn as possible to overwhelm the opponent and win through a large storm count.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures with high power and toughness, supported by burn spells for removal and disruption. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient creature-based assault while also controlling the board with removal spells. The deck aims to close out games quickly through efficient use of mana and maximization of damage output. The inclusion of Leyline cards helps to protect key creatures and maintain board presence, while also providing additional benefits.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Arena of Glory to control the board. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls provide additional support for the aggressive strategy, while cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Seasoned Pyromancer and Voice of Victory allows for card advantage and additional threats to be deployed.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creature and burn spells, supported by cards like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional reach and reach to finish off opponents quickly. Overall, this Boros Aggro deck prioritizes fast, aggressive gameplay to secure victories in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on ramping up quickly with the UrzaTron lands to play powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with counterspells and removal spells. The key strategy is to assemble the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana to cast big threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. The deck also uses cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Sowing Mycospawn to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void to control the board.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and powerful anthems like Voice of Victory to boost the team's power. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal, and ways to pump up their team, this deck aims to apply pressure early and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on maximizing mana acceleration through Birthing Ritual and Coiling Oracle to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Endurance. It also includes disruptive spells like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation to protect your board state. The deck aims to maintain tempo and control the game while building towards a strong late-game presence. Additionally, it utilizes cards like Misty Rainforest and Snow-Covered lands for efficient mana fixing. Overall, the deck combines aggro and control elements to create a versatile and aggressive gameplay strategy.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disruption, card draw, and versatile removal to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan, combined with efficient removal like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to keep the opponent's threats in check. This control strategy is further supported by card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Psychic Frog, allowing the player to pull ahead in resources and eventually close out the game with powerful finishers like Murktide Regent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge to deal direct damage. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and allows for creature recursion. The deck also features control elements like Static Prison and Seasoned Pyromancer to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, this deck aims to win the game swiftly through aggressive creature plays and efficient removal options.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's hand and board while ramping up mana with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells like Damnation, Torment of Hailfire, and Gaze of Granite, while also utilizing cards like Resentful Revelation and Dark Petition to draw into key pieces and answers. The deck relies on resource management, efficient removal, and high-impact threats to dominate the game and secure victory.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creature plays and blink effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain an advantage. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to repeatedly exile and return creatures, the deck can trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects multiple times. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal to control the opponent's board, while cards like Relic of Progenitus help to disrupt graveyard strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and disruptive plays to secure a quick victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive and fast-paced gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Supporting cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Static Prison help maintain board control and lock down opposing threats. The deck also includes disruption elements like Goblin Bombardment and Voice of Victory to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and control elements to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive play using a combination of creatures and spells to deal quick damage to the opponent. It utilizes efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to keep the pressure on. The deck also includes support cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board and protect its threats. With a mix of speed, control, and powerful creatures, this Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.
